description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted the seventh Patient Qualification and Safety Committee meeting for the Medical Psilocybin Advisory Board. The Chair, Ian Dunn, facilitated review and approval on the Consolidated Recommendations, and review of the documents on major depressive disorder, cluster headaches and existential distress.
